# Keccak-f iota constants

iota XORs RC[i] into lane (0,0) only. Other 24 lanes untouched.
Bits that may be 1 sit at positions 2^j-1 (j=0..6 for w=64): 0,1,3,7,15,31,63.
Those bits come from an 8-bit LFSR (poly x^8+x^6+x^5+x^4+1).
Role: break symmetry. Without iota, all-zero is a fixed point of theta-rho-pi-chi and rounds are identical maps.
